title: MR Office AI Adds a Revenue Column For You

viewer.problem: Calculating totals and revenue columns by hand is slow
viewer.job: Let the built-in AI add formulas, totals and highlights

idea: Show MR Office's built-in AI spreadsheet editing as a fast animated demonstration grounded in a real captured sheet.

claims.text: MR Office has a built-in AI assistant in the spreadsheet editor that edits cells and formulas; proposed changes are reviewed before applying and can be undone.
A free account adds the AI assistant with a daily allowance.

proof_plan.how_shown: Real MR Office editor captured anonymously with the actual sales data typed in (before state); the AI transformation is an animated demonstration labelled on screen, per owner instruction. No account was accessed.

review.notes: Owner watched the finished Short and approved it for scheduling ('its good'), then requested Buffer + YouTube scheduling for today evening New York. Animated feature demonstration; real before-state capture; AI narration.

youtube.title: MR Office AI Adds a Revenue Column For You
youtube.description:
Still calculating spreadsheet totals by hand? In MR Office, you ask the built-in AI: add a Revenue column (Units × Unit Price), total everything, and highlight the top seller.

Result: Laptop $10,200 · Monitor $3,960 · Keyboard $1,575 · Mouse $1,000 · TOTAL $16,735.

The before sheet is the real MR Office editor; the AI edit is shown as an animated demonstration of the built-in assistant's review-and-apply flow. AI-generated narration.
